source: Recorded guarded liver contact and coupled scene; retrained with the v2 visible-lift objective using 12 real UCB episodes and three held-out stiffness checks.

materials.scope: Existing inverse SLS estimator with bounded physical refinement applied to 12 explicit synthetic scene-design histories. Not learned from Full.mp4, biological organ-specific training, measured human properties, or clinical validation.

video_mechanics_calibration.reason: Unknown loads, scale, boundary conditions and camera calibration; a rendered monocular demonstration cannot identify absolute tissue stiffness.

materials.parameter_intervals_scope: Synthetic inverse-model uncertainty only; no coverage claim for human tissues or model-form mismatch.
materials.density_provenance: Authored mass-density assumptions, never inferred by the inverse model.
materials.attachment_scope: This table assigns material responses. Attachments, rigid supports and sliding contacts must be implemented by the scene solver.

wall_boundary.explanation: The v1 material schema has no constraint field. Higher modulus is not a tether.

materials.inference_method: Protocol-conditioned neural ensemble proposal followed by existing bounded robust physical refinement; no estimator retraining.

generation.deterministic_seed_scheme: First 32 bits of SHA256(viscera-virtamed-design-v1:<organ-id>); xorshift32 and Box-Muller noise.

held_out_validation.scope: New protocols and amplitudes not used in fitting, generated by the same SLS constitutive family. This demonstrates synthetic parameter recovery, not biological validation.
